data.notes: March 2027 is already anchored by Lollapalooza Brasil, with a few confirmed arena and large-venue pop, MPB and dance-adjacent concerts around it; São Paulo club calendars are not yet meaningfully announced this far out.

events.title: Lollapalooza Brasil 2027
events.summary: Lollapalooza Brasil 2027 is confirmed for 19–21 March at Autódromo de Interlagos. Announced top-billed names include Travis Scott, Charli XCX, David Guetta, The Killers, Queens of the Stone Age, The Prodigy and Mochakk.

events.title: Jão | Turnê Memórias Póstumas
events.summary: Brazilian pop star Jão is confirmed at Nubank Parque on 27 March 2027 for the Memórias Póstumas tour. Eventim lists the São Paulo show with gates at 16:00 and the stadium venue at Av. Francisco Matarazzo, 1705.

events.title: Jungle - World Tour 2027
events.summary: UK dance-soul band Jungle are confirmed for Espaço Unimed on 30 March 2027 at 21:30. The Eventim listing frames the São Paulo date as part of the Jungle World Tour 2027.

events.title: Cabaret Voltaire — Final Tour
events.summary: A rare São Paulo date for the industrial/electronic pioneers on their farewell tour, positioned more for post-punk, EBM, synth and experimental-electronic heads than the mainstream concert circuit.

events.title: SideChain Festival - 1° Edição: Pressure Factory
events.summary: Metro-area underground hi-BPM gathering in Mairiporã focused on Brazilian acelero culture, collectives, local artists and community-building rather than mainstream EDM festival booking.

events.title: Vice-Versa | Arnaldo Antunes e Adriana Calcanhotto
events.summary: Arnaldo Antunes and Adriana Calcanhotto bring their collaborative Vice-Versa project to Espaço Unimed, with the São Paulo date listed for 6 March 2027 at 22:00. The show is built around their joint album plus reworked songs from both artists’ catalogues.

events.title: Fernando & Sorocaba
events.summary: The sertanejo/country duo Fernando & Sorocaba are confirmed for Tokio Marine Hall on 12 March 2027 at 22:00. The Ticketmaster event page bills the show around the duo’s connection between Brazilian sertanejo and country music.
